criteria.name: Medallion & architecture design
criteria.description: Clear raw→Bronze design, sensible Volume/catalog layout, README explains the data flow.

criteria.name: Ingestion implementation
criteria.description: Working ingestion (batch + Auto Loader), incremental/idempotent, metadata columns present.

criteria.name: Delta & data handling
criteria.description: Correct use of Delta tables, schema handling, and preservation of raw fidelity in Bronze.

criteria.name: Documentation & ops
criteria.description: Data dictionary, setup notes, and evidence the pipeline runs without guesswork.

criteria.name: Cleaning & data quality
criteria.description: Typed, deduplicated Silver with explicit quality rules and a quarantine path.

criteria.name: Dimensional model
criteria.description: Coherent star schema (fact + dimensions), surrogate keys, defined grain.

criteria.name: Correctness & reconciliation
criteria.description: Gold totals reconcile with Silver; KPIs defined precisely and computed correctly.

criteria.name: Documentation
criteria.description: Design doc, KPI definitions, and readable, well-structured notebooks.

criteria.name: Pipeline design
criteria.description: Declarative Bronze→Silver→Gold pipeline with clean dataset boundaries.

criteria.name: Reliability & quality
criteria.description: Expectations, retries, timeouts, and notifications configured sensibly.

criteria.name: Reproducibility
criteria.description: Orchestrated job + Asset Bundle deploy the project from code.

criteria.name: Write-up & repo hygiene
criteria.description: Write-up matches the repo; structure is navigable and versioned.

criteria.name: Governance & security
criteria.description: Unity Catalog grants, lineage, and row filters/column masks protect PHI appropriately.

criteria.name: Analytics & AI/BI
criteria.description: Databricks SQL queries, a clear AI/BI dashboard, and a grounded Genie space.

criteria.name: End-to-end demo
criteria.description: Live walkthrough from raw file to dashboard/Genie, with lineage traced back to source.

criteria.name: Repo hygiene & roadmap
